<script>
(function () {
  var event = {
    title:       'WOMBAT 2026',
    description: 'Workshop Organised by the Monash Business Analytics Team. Learn and discuss open-source tools for business analytics and data science.',
    location:    'Melbourne, Australia',
    url:         'https://wombat.numbat.space',
    startDate:   '20261130',   // YYYYMMDD (all-day)
    endDate:     '20261202',   // iCal end is exclusive, so +1 day after last day
    startDateHuman: '2026-11-30',
    endDateHuman:   '2026-12-01'
  };

  // ── iCal content ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var ics = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//WOMBAT 2026//EN',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    'METHOD:PUBLISH',
    'BEGIN:VEVENT',
    'UID:wombat-2026@numbat.space',
    'DTSTAMP:' + new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z',
    'DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:' + event.startDate,
    'DTEND;VALUE=DATE:'   + event.endDate,
    'SUMMARY:'      + event.title,
    'DESCRIPTION:'  + event.description,
    'LOCATION:'     + event.location,
    'URL:'          + event.url,
    'END:VEVENT',
    'END:VCALENDAR'
  ].join('\r\n');

  var icsDataURI = 'data:text/calendar;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(ics);

  // ── Google Calendar URL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var googleURL = 'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE' +
    '&text='     + encodeURIComponent(event.title) +
    '&dates='    + event.startDate + '/' + event.endDate +
    '&details='  + encodeURIComponent(event.description) +
    '&location=' + encodeURIComponent(event.location) +
    '&sprop=website:' + encodeURIComponent(event.url);

  // ── Outlook Web URL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var outlookURL = 'https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose?path=/calendar/action/compose&rru=addevent' +
    '&subject='   + encodeURIComponent(event.title) +
    '&startdt='   + event.startDateHuman +
    '&enddt='     + event.endDateHuman +
    '&body='      + encodeURIComponent(event.description) +
    '&location='  + encodeURIComponent(event.location) +
    '&allday=true';

  document.getElementById('cal-google').href  = googleURL;
  document.getElementById('cal-outlook').href = outlookURL;
  document.getElementById('cal-ical').href    = icsDataURI;
  document.getElementById('cal-ics').href     = icsDataURI;
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var nav1 = document.getElementById('nav-day1');
  var nav2 = document.getElementById('nav-day2');
  var day2 = document.getElementById('day2');

  if (!nav1 || !nav2 || !day2) return;

  function update() {
    var switchAt = window.innerHeight * 0.4;
    var showDay2 = day2.getBoundingClientRect().top <= switchAt;
    nav1.classList.toggle('is-active', !showDay2);
    nav2.classList.toggle('is-active', showDay2);
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true });
  update();
})();
</script>

The annual WOMBAT workshop brings together analysts from academia, industry and government to learn and discuss open source tools for business analytics and data science.

You should come if you are an analytics professional, lead a team of analysts, or develop open source tools.

## Registration

Registration for WOMBAT will open nearer to the event.

Attendance will be limited to 20 participants (in-person and online) for each of the 8 tutorials on day 1, and 100 participants (in-person only) for day 2's workshop. We will also have a rich collection of hex stickers available for all to choose from to decorate your laptop.

### Tutorials

The WOMBAT tutorials offer practical, hands-on training in key topics for data analysis by experts in the field. Each tutorial includes three hours of content with a 30-minute catered tea break, offered in both morning (AM) and afternoon (PM) sessions.

### Workshop

The main day of WOMBAT features a diverse workshop program designed to highlight the latest data analysis tools and techniques. The workshop includes a keynote presentation, followed by invited talks from leading data analysts from academia, government, and industry. More details about the workshop will be shared nearer to the event.
